newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh launches programme to save river.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh launches programme to save river.

text.p: Bangladesh has launched a project to save a river, the Buriganga, that is being choked by pollution, a newspaper said on Tuesday.
"We have launched Save Buriganga programme," the Bengali daily Bhorer Kagoj quoted the chief of the Department of Environment (DOE), Saiyid Mosharraf Hussain, as saying.

Environment officials said the Buriganga, flowing south from the Bangladesh capital Dhaka, was polluted by discharges from hundreds of factories and riverside markets as well as by human excreta from thousands of open latrines.
The DOE says factories release 23,000 cubic metres of untreated waste water into the Buriganga every day.
